limitations: Phase 4 artifacts are deterministic fixture-tested contracts; no live production Flickr or GBIF inference was run.
Outlier diagnostics do not assess or prove taxonomic misidentification.
Provisional ranking emits uncalibrated similarity and margin, never probability.
No measured quality, time or review-work improvement is claimed.
phase_name: Reference embeddings, prototypes and fast scoring

tasks.outcome: Embedding rows bind admission/review evidence while the vector cache remains content-and-model keyed.
Normalized, balanced mean-centered, trimmed, medoid and clustered robust prototypes with evidence counts.
Centroid, leave-one-out, peer, competitor, influence, route and outlier diagnostics without relabeling.
Raw prototype/reference ranking with competitor margin, no probability and mandatory review state.
